title: The dashboard is green, but is it fresh?
briefing: A payments dashboard turned green after a configuration change. Decide whether recovery is real. Evidence timestamps and independent customer checks matter.
learning_objective: Check telemetry freshness and independent customer signals before trusting apparent recovery.

evidence.text: Payments error dashboard displays 0.1% errors. The snapshot was generated 18 minutes ago; the incident started 12 minutes ago.
Metrics ingestion stopped 18 minutes ago. The dashboard continues rendering its last cached point.
Independent synthetic checkout probe: 24% failures over the most recent minute. Three support tickets report current payment failures.
Change pay-routing-62 sent requests to a retired upstream. Service owner verified previous config pay-routing-61 and approved a simulated restore.

actions.label: Restore the verified previous payment route
actions.outcome: Verified route restoration requested in the simulation; a green cached dashboard remains insufficient.

effects.text: Independent probe now succeeds on 99.9% of checkouts over 3 minutes. Payment reconciliation shows no new mismatch.

actions.label: Restart the synthetic telemetry pipeline
actions.outcome: Telemetry pipeline restart simulated; observe a fresh sample before using it.

effects.text: Metrics pipeline publishes a point generated at the current simulation minute. Its source timestamp and ingestion heartbeat are both current.

actions.label: Declare verified customer recovery
actions.outcome: Recovery recorded with fresh independent customer and telemetry evidence.
